items.source:
ExecutableRemoveOperation allows creation and execution of MongoDB remove / findAndRemove operations in a fluent API style.
The starting domainType is used for mapping the Query provided via matching into the MongoDB specific representation. The collection to operate on is by default derived from the initial domainType and can be defined there via Document. Using inCollection allows to override the collection name for the execution. 
    
        remove(Jedi.class)
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .matching(query(where("firstname").is("luke")))
            .all();
items.translation:
ExecutableRemoveOperation 支持以流畅 API 风格创建并执行 MongoDB 的删除/查找并删除操作。
起始的 domainType 用于将通过 matching 提供的 Query 映射到 MongoDB 特定表示形式。要操作的集合默认从初始 domainType 派生，并可通过 Document 在该处定义。使用 inCollection 可覆盖执行时的集合名称。 
    
        remove(Jedi.class)
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .matching(query(where("firstname").is("luke")))
            .all();
